  -- Result: Continued to note the lack of complete producer credits on the Wikipedia page.
- Agent: Planner
  -- Action: Analyzed the previous results and decided to continue gathering producer credits from authoritative sources.
  -- Observation: Noted that the Wikipedia page only partially confirmed the producer credits and that IMDb was another authoritative source to consult.
  -- Thought: Determined that the next step was to extract producer credits from the IMDb page to get a more complete list.
  -- Result: Instructed the WebSurfer to open the IMDb page for The Lego Batman Movie and extract producer credits.
- Agent: WebSurfer
  -- Action: Opened the IMDb full credits page for The Lego Batman Movie.
  -- Observation: Extracted producer credits from the IMDb page, including Dan Lin, Phil Lord, Christopher Miller, and Roy Lee.
  -- Thought: Confirmed the producer credits from the IMDb page and noted any discrepancies with the Wikipedia page.
  -- Result: Provided a more complete list of producer credits from the IMDb page.
